contracts.commit_point: The two execute_query UPDATE statements inside process_refund that persist invoices.status='refunded' and orders.status='returned' (backend/tools/billing_tools.py:90-91).
contracts.declared_mechanism: HumanInTheLoopMiddleware(interrupt_on={'process_refund': {'allowed_decisions': ['approve', 'reject'], 'description': 'Refund processing requires support lead approval before execution.'}}) registered in the billing agent's middleware stack; interrupt resolution via POST /admin/approve-refund/{conversation_id}, which calls _auth_admin(x_admin_token) (verify_admin_token) and then resumes the graph with Command(resume={'decisions': [decision]}).
contracts.forbidden_condition: Execution of process_refund's database mutations (invoices.status='refunded' and orders.status='returned') while the registered human-approval interrupt is unresolved — i.e., before an approve/reject decision is returned via the Command(resume=...) invocation on the admin-authenticated /admin/approve-refund path. Source also declares the condition normatively: 'process_refund is sensitive and must only run through the human-approval interrupt path' and the tool docstring states 'Requires human approval before execution.'

contracts.protected_operation: Agent-invoked execution of the process_refund tool for a customer order refund.
contracts.protected_resource: The invoices and orders rows for the targeted order_id (invoice status set to 'refunded'; order status set to 'returned').
contracts.protection_obligation: The billing agent's process_refund tool must not execute its refund database mutations until the HumanInTheLoopMiddleware interrupt registered on process_refund is resolved by a human support-lead decision (approve/reject) delivered through the admin-token-gated resume endpoint POST /admin/approve-refund/{conversation_id}.
scope_limits: Applies only to process_refund; the interrupt_on map registers no interrupt for the other billing tools. update_payment_dispute also performs an invoice mutation (backend/tools/billing_tools.py:107-119) with no registered approval gate, and is not covered by this obligation.

The admin gate on the resume path is conditional: _auth_admin enforces verify_admin_token only when settings.ADMIN_PASSWORD is set (backend/api/main.py:158-160); the supplied source does not establish that it is configured in the deployment.

The refund confirmation sequencing in BILLING_PROMPT (backend/agents/billing_agent.py:26-32) is prompt-level policy, not a code-enforced guard; the code-enforced mechanism is the middleware interrupt plus the admin resume path.
The protected effect is limited to the MySQL updates shown in source; no external payment-provider call is present in the supplied process_refund body.
The /chat endpoint itself performs no admin authentication; the approval flow depends entirely on the separate /admin endpoints.
